card.description: Plans return train journeys in Karnataka from the live Deccan Rail timetable.
card.name: Deccan Rail Trip Planner

skills.description: Given a request in plain English, finds the outbound and return trains, respecting time of day and window-seat wishes.
examples: Bengaluru to Mysuru on Saturday morning, back on Sunday evening, window seats.
skills.name: Plan a return trip

direct.request: Bengaluru to Mysuru on Saturday morning and back on Sunday evening, window seats both ways.

parts.text:
Here is a two-sentence itinerary for the traveller:

On Saturday morning, take the 16017 Chamundi Fast Passenger from Bengaluru at 09:15, enjoying a window seat and arriving in Mysuru by 12:05. On Sunday evening, return to Bengaluru on the 16034 Sandalwood Return Express, departing Mysuru at 19:30 and arriving back by 22:05 with a window seat.
OUTBOUND: 16017
RETURN: 16034

delegated.reply: I'll delegate this task to the A2A agent to plan the return trip.
